propositions: Two regex patterns in gates.py and det_floor.py currently match '## Success Criteria' heading to award +2 clarity bonus for epics; they must be repointed to '## Acceptance Criteria' to unify the heading vocabulary and enable store migration verification.
The _SCOPE_HEADINGS list in assemble.py includes both 'success criteria' and 'acceptance criteria' entries; the SC entry must be removed to collapse the dual heading vocabulary.

Test fixtures across seven files currently embed the retired '## Success Criteria' heading; fixtures carrying both headings must drop the SC block, and fixtures carrying SC as their only criteria block must be renamed to '## Acceptance Criteria' with bullets converted to checkbox format.
Repointing the epic branch bonus from SC to AC keeps the clarity score at 6 (unchanged from today), preventing fixture fragility and avoiding a live regression across 108 migrated tickets.

The two _clarity_score copies in gates.py and det_floor.py must remain textually in lockstep per their existing comments and a new assertion must verify _clarity_score(fixture, 'epic') == 6 after the repoint.
